What if you rubbed your eyes every day?
Tired, itchy or dry eyes make people rub them without thinking. It feels so good when they're tired. Rubbing can trigger a reflex that slows your heartbeat a little, which is why it feels calming.

But here's the twist. Your hands can spread germs to your eyes, and lots of hard rubbing over the years is linked to keratoconus, where the cornea thins into a cone shape! If your eyes itch a lot, allergy drops or a cool compress are better. Eye doctors say if you have to touch your eyes, wash your hands first.
